resources.title: [EN] Team Falcons vs Xtreme Gaming - Game 5 - The International 2025 - Grand Final
resources.creator: dota2
resources.noteEs: Partida 5 decisiva de la Grand Final de TI 2025 (Falcons 3-2 Xtreme Gaming). 63 minutos donde Falcons drafteó alrededor de un Medusa late game y desmanteló a XG cerca del minuto 58. Subido oficialmente por el canal de Valve. La partida que coronó al primer Aegis de Falcons.
resources.noteEn: Decisive Game 5 of the TI 2025 Grand Final (Falcons 3-2 Xtreme Gaming). 63 minutes where Falcons drafted around a late-game Medusa and dismantled XG around minute 58. Officially uploaded by Valve's channel. The match that crowned Falcons' first Aegis.
